text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock B in pieces as it rose, and felt satisfaction locking in gains; I should weigh its prospects and portfolio role rather than sell just to secure a win.","Selling Stocks D and E at large losses was painful, but avoiding a sale just to avoid realizing a loss can be as costly; I should reassess each holding objectively.","My account value fell substantially despite several trades, so I should make deliberate decisions based on risk, diversification, and a clear plan—not react to short-term price moves."]}
